recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Any future rephrasing of the existing client-submitted-format wording would be editorial follow-up rather than required FHIR-16329 reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-16329 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core formats issue requesting that unsupported requested response formats use 406 Not Acceptable instead of 415 Unsupported Media Type, and that the page distinguish 406 for Accept-header response-format conflicts from 415 for unsupported client-submitted formats.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 13991, imported as git commit 8b0d067ddf9e780da3ade80fb764d6d5ce095b19, which changed source/formats.html to use 406 and added the 406/415 distinction. Commit fb6236f76aef7e34c5874572f098f3a646dcc983 later moved the wire-format section to source/resource-formats.html while preserving that text.
additional_context: The current source no longer has the wire-format section in source/formats.html. The active source/resource-formats.html page contains the wire anchor and is linked from source/documentation.html, and source/http.html also contains the same content-type status-code distinction. Targeted Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later directly relevant conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/resource-formats.html and source/http.html already describe 406 for unsupported requested response formats and 415 for unsupported client-submitted formats.

related_jiras.note: Later refactor split the former formats.html wire section into source/resource-formats.html and preserved the FHIR-16329 406/415 guidance.
